extra_citations.why: Max-margin implicit bias of depth-L linear conv nets is an l_{2/L} bridge penalty in the FREQUENCY domain. This is the closest precedent for Fourier features acquiring a concave per-feature price under margin with L2 on factors. Cite it with Hoff/Kolb and scope the novelty claim.
